origins.section: The Compiler Rejects a Test That Can Never Be True, Judging Only the Declared Types
A Class Is Its Name and the Loader That Defined It
Arrays Keep Their Element Type at Run Time; Generic Types Lose Their Type Arguments
instanceof Asks About the Object's Class at Run Time, and null Has None

recorded.prompt:q-two-helpers:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-two-helpers:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-two-helpers:d: The same passage makes finality the reason a test is rejected, and a non-final class the reason it compiles, so swapping the two is refuted.
